title: What technique should you use to photograph jewelry? E-commerce photo tutorial
h1: Photographing Jewelry: Pro Techniques for Jewelers
metaTitle: How to Photograph Jewelry: Professional Techniques for Jewelers
description: Master the demanding art of jewelry photography with our exclusive tips: advanced lighting, Hyperfocus technology, and 360° animations. Discover how to enhance diamonds and precious stones for your jewelry e-commerce store.
author: PackshotCreator
content:
Photographing jewelry requires unique precision to capture all of its beauty and its sheen. Diamonds, rubies, sapphires, or emeralds: each precious stone tells a unique story and deserves a tailored approach that fully reveals its natural splendor. Discover how to turn each piece of jewelry into a fascinating visual using modern and effective techniques.

Jewelry photography: a demanding art

Jewelry photography requires particular attention to detail, light, and focus, much more so than conventional photography of large objects. Each piece of jewelry has specific characteristics, such as the brilliance of the stones, the fineness of the setting, or the unique texture of the materials used.

Choosing a specialized photo studio: essential technical criteria

Choosing a suitable studio is crucial to precisely meeting the technical requirements of jewelry photography. Studios specifically dedicated to macro photography and small objects, such as the Orbitvu Alphashot Micro V2, offer several decisive advantages. For example, they allow exact reproduction of shades and hues thanks to accurate color rendering, ensure uniform sharpness over the entire depth of the piece thanks to Focus Stacking technology, and offer precise and adjustable lighting that perfectly controls reflections and sparkle.

Advanced lighting techniques to enhance precious stones

To fully reveal the brilliance of a diamond, a ruby, or an emerald, mastering lighting is indispensable. By using adjustable light sources, you can effectively enhance the essential characteristics of the stones, such as their cut, clarity, polish, and symmetry. Well-controlled lighting can faithfully replicate the brilliance found in high-end jewelry and eliminate unwanted shadows that can hide important details.

‍

‍

Practical tips: succeed in your jewelry photography

A few simple tips can dramatically improve the quality of your photographs. Use a neutral background, such as white or light gray, to better highlight the piece and simplify cutouts in post-production. Adjust your lighting carefully, starting at a low intensity and then gradually increasing it to control reflections. Use light diffusers to avoid overly pronounced reflections on shiny surfaces. To create 360° animations, rotate the piece of jewelry rather than your camera, ensuring a consistent result.

Concrete testimony: Gad & Co and Orbitvu efficiency

To illustrate the benefits of suitable equipment in concrete terms, here is the testimonial of Benzi Gad, marketing manager at Gad & Co:

“Since using Orbitvu, the process has become much more efficient. Today, we easily take more than 100 photos per day, effectively feeding our e-commerce business with consistent quality. The return on investment since the acquisition of the Alphashot Micro has been absolutely exceptional.”

‍

‍

360° animations: enriching the user experience

360° animations offer your customers an exceptional interactive experience. They can fully explore each piece from every angle and use a precise progressive zoom to observe details such as the hallmarks, finish, or setting. These smooth animations are perfectly optimized for e-commerce platforms.

‍

‍

Simplifying post-production: how to optimize your visuals

Thanks to modern software integrated into specialized studios, post-production becomes both fast and intuitive. You can easily make accurate color corrections, adjust contrast and brightness to refine each image, and automate background removal to ensure a consistent, professional look.

‍

‍

Summary of practical tips for successful jewelry photography

  • Select equipment that is suitable for macro photography.
  • Control the lighting to reveal even the smallest details.
  • Use Hyperfocus technology to ensure perfect sharpness.
  • Offer interactive animations to significantly improve the user experience.

By applying these tips, you ensure a professional visual presentation that will fully enhance each piece of jewelry, thus making your product catalog more attractive.

faqs.question: How does high-end jewelry photography differ from other types of product photography?
faqs.answer: High-end jewelry photography transcends simple visual documentation to become an art of microscopic precision. Unlike traditional product photography, it requires exceptional technical mastery and a thorough understanding of the optical properties of gems. Each piece of jewelry is unique, with its own characteristics of refraction, light dispersion, and crystalline structure. This specificity requires not only photographic expertise, but also gemological knowledge to accurately capture the essence and true value of each creation.

faqs.question: How many photos can I expect to take per day with the right equipment?
faqs.answer: With specialized equipment like Orbitvu's Alphashot Micro, it is possible to take more than 100 photos per day while maintaining consistent quality, as evidenced by the Gad & Co experience mentioned in the article.

faqs.question: What technical criteria are essential for choosing a photo studio specializing in jewelry?
faqs.answer: A suitable studio must offer exact reproduction of shades and hues (faithful color rendering), uniform sharpness over the entire depth of the piece (Focus Stacking technology), and precise, adjustable lighting to perfectly control reflections and sparkle.

faqs.question: How is Hyperfocus technology revolutionizing the sharpness of jewelry images?
faqs.answer: Hyperfocus technology (or Advanced Focus Stacking) represents a major evolution in fine jewelry photography. Unlike traditional focus stacking, this sophisticated approach uses proprietary algorithms that analyze the jewelry's three-dimensional topography and automatically calculate the optimal focus sequences. The Alphashot Micro V2 can capture up to 200 images at various focal planes with micrometer increments (as accurate as 10 microns) and then intelligently merge them while maintaining depth information. This technique overcomes the depth-of-field limitations inherent in macro lenses and allows microscopic details of the setting, the surface texture of the metal, and the internal characteristics of gemstones to be visualized simultaneously, a level of detail impossible to achieve with conventional methods.

faqs.question: How do you create professional-quality 360° animations?
faqs.answer: To create quality 360° animations, rotate the jewelry rather than the camera to ensure a consistent result, keep the light consistent throughout the sequence, use specialized equipment like the Alphashot Micro that automates this process, and make sure that the animations are smooth and optimized for e-commerce platforms.
